name: Korean Demilitarized Zone
story: The Korean Demilitarized Zone is a strip of land running across the Korean Peninsula in South Korea. Established in 1953, it is 250 kilometers long and about 4 kilometers wide, serving as a heavily militarized border barrier.
matters: A population of the long-tailed goral, an endangered species classified as South Korean natural monument 217, exists in the Korean Demilitarized Zone.
